files.spec.md:
Implement a JSON decision program, not JavaScript. Shape: {"rules":[{"when":{"field":{"gte":0,"lt":10}},"then":value}],"default":value}. The checker runs only this trusted bounded interpreter; not a general JS correctness test.
Input {subtotalCents: integer 0..100000, remote:boolean}. remote always costs 1200; nonremote subtotal >=5000 ships free, otherwise 500. Remote overrides free shipping.
